pages.title: Snatch
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r V$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks have a chance to knock enemy weapons and armor out of their hands; higher levels give a higher chance. Weapon drop chance: I=10%, II=20%, III=40%, IV=60%, V=80%; armor drop chance is half that of weapons.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r I-III from Enchanting Table, IV-V only from Structure Loot Chests
